title: Cardholder Points on Authorized Store Replacements
content:
Crestline Credit Card standing adds points to the coverage percentage of a store replacement the holder of a Road Hazard Protection certificate authorizes in person.

**Authorization card points.** A holder who has a Crestline Credit Card account in status active and no late fee posted on their Crestline card accounts in the last 12 whole calendar months adds 5 points to the authorization coverage percentage; a holder with an active Crestline card account and one or more such late fees in that period adds 2 points; any other holder adds no authorization card points.

| Holder | Points |
|---|---|
| active Crestline card account, no late fee in the last 12 whole months | 5 |
| active Crestline card account, one or more late fees in that period | 2 |
| no active Crestline card account | 0 |
